function: Private web control center, manual Windows bridge and Android updates
trigger: Manual authenticated web launch; Windows connector polls every 10 seconds while started; Android update requested from the native application
expected: control_center_mode=windows_bridge; windows_publication_enabled=true; android_publication_enabled=false; healthy database; latest APK coherent and signed
normal_exclusions: Zero publications or disconnected Windows without a manual launch
Android periodic diagnostics can be delayed
Other social adapters refused before publication until validated
symptom: Invalid control contract, unavailable official latest APK, claimed publication without a result after 15 minutes
diagnostic: Public health contract and official release metadata; inspect private reports only with the active owner; never replay ambiguous publications
repair: Restore HTTPS or the isolated control release; reconnect the known Windows executor; inspect own provider status and preserve one-attempt journals
rollback: Previous backend release and latest APK pointer; retain confirmed/uncertain publication reservations and Android encrypted association
illustrated_template: Existing StoryFX maintenance alert; approval and delivery not revalidated by this milestone
